title: Product formula for circuit agreement
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $C$ be a directed acyclic circuit with $n$ Boolean inputs, gates ordered so each gate reads only earlier vertices, and a valid output vertex. Under the uniform distribution on Boolean functions on $n$ inputs, the probability that a random function agrees with the function computed by $C$ at every input equals the product, over all inputs $x$, of the probability that it agrees with the circuit's value at $x$.
hypotheses_covered: The gates are ordered so each gate reads only earlier vertices
The output is a circuit vertex
